summary: Defines SNMP managed objects for configuring and monitoring an MPLS label switching router, the device that forwards packets by looking at short labels instead of full IP addresses. It covers the router's interfaces, label mappings and cross-connects.

eli5.summary: A mail sorter reads a small sticker on each package instead of the whole address. This document defines a standard clipboard for checking how the sorter is set up.

questions: how to monitor an mpls label switching router with snmp
